act: SURVIVAL ON THE +1/+2 LENSES (D-H = H2, capped; fix plan F1): exit risk is probability-based survival S_k(age, games) fitted on the TRUE listing outcome over played rows (on an AFL list at the end of Y+k | listed at the end of Y), spread across each age cohort by EVIDENCE (S_k(age_i, g_i) / R_k(age_i), the cohort's evidence mix at the row's own age; ages >= 33 pooled) with the multiplier capped at 1.0 — nobody rises for survival; 0-game players carry no fitted S and are not charged (their vP is a pick-curve expectation that already averages over busts). Present values untouched.
